# Zivel

> Zivel is a science-backed wellness franchise brand offering recovery, performance, and aesthetics services across 19 studio locations in the United States. Every service is selected based on peer-reviewed research and clinical evidence.

Tagline: Recover Smarter. Look Better. Feel Stronger.

[Zivel Homepage](https://www.zivel.com): Main website with services, locations, and booking.

## Services

Zivel offers eight core service modalities:

- **Cryotherapy** — Whole-body cold exposure (2–3 min, ultra-low temperatures) for recovery, inflammation reduction, and energy. [Cryotherapy](https://www.zivel.com/services/cryotherapy): Service detail page with protocols, benefits, and booking.
- **Red Light Therapy** — Near-infrared and red wavelength light panels for cellular energy, skin health, and muscle recovery. [Red Light Therapy](https://www.zivel.com/services/red-light-therapy): Service detail page with protocols, benefits, and booking.
- **Infrared Sauna** — Full-spectrum infrared heat for detoxification, cardiovascular support, and deep relaxation. [Infrared Sauna](https://www.zivel.com/services/infrared-sauna): Service detail page with protocols, benefits, and booking.
- **Dry Float** — Zero-gravity pod sessions using Epsom salt solution for decompression, stress relief, and nervous system reset. [Dry Float](https://www.zivel.com/services/dry-float): Service detail page with protocols, benefits, and booking.
- **Cryo Slimming** — Non-invasive body contouring using controlled cold to target and reduce localized fat cells. [Cryo Slimming](https://www.zivel.com/services/cryo-slimming): Service detail page with protocols, benefits, and booking.
- **Cryo Toning** — Thermal contrast technique alternating cold and mild warmth to firm and tone skin. [Cryo Toning](https://www.zivel.com/services/cryo-toning): Service detail page with protocols, benefits, and booking.
- **CryoLift Facial** — Cryo-based facial treatment reducing puffiness, tightening skin, and improving complexion. [CryoLift Facial](https://www.zivel.com/services/cryo-lift-facial): Service detail page with protocols, benefits, and booking.
- **Compression Therapy** — Pneumatic compression sleeves for lymphatic drainage, circulation, and recovery. [Compression Therapy](https://www.zivel.com/services/compression-therapy): Service detail page with protocols, benefits, and booking.

[All Services](https://www.zivel.com/services): Complete index of Zivel wellness and recovery service offerings.

## Wellness Pathways

Zivel organizes services into goal-based Pathways — curated multi-service programs aligned to specific outcomes:

- **Recovery** — Reduce soreness, support healing, and return to peak performance faster. [Recovery Pathway](https://www.zivel.com/pathways/recovery): Recommended service stack for recovery goals.
- **Performance** — Optimize energy, endurance, and physical output. [Performance Pathway](https://www.zivel.com/pathways/performance): Recommended service stack for performance goals.
- **Beauty** — Improve skin quality, tone, and facial appearance. [Beauty Pathway](https://www.zivel.com/pathways/beauty): Recommended service stack for aesthetic goals.
- **Longevity** — Support cellular health, inflammation control, and long-term vitality. [Longevity Pathway](https://www.zivel.com/pathways/longevity): Recommended service stack for longevity goals.

[All Pathways](https://www.zivel.com/pathways): Overview of all goal-based wellness pathway programs.

## Memberships

Zivel offers membership plans that provide discounted access to services across all studio locations. Membership details and pricing vary by location.

[Memberships](https://www.zivel.com/memberships): Membership tiers, pricing, and benefits overview.
